title: HDFC Bank announces 15% dividend, board approves stock buyback
content: HDFC Bank today announced a 15% dividend for its shareholders along with a major stock buyback program approved by the board of directors. The move is seen as a positive signal for investors.

title: RBI raises repo rate by 25bps to 6.75%, citing inflation concerns
content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has increased the repo rate by 25 basis points to 6.75%. The central bank cited rising inflation concerns as the primary reason for this decision.

title: ICICI Bank opens 500 new branches across Tier-2 cities
content: In a major expansion drive, ICICI Bank announced the opening of 500 new branches, focusing heavily on Tier-2 cities to increase financial inclusion and capture rural markets.

title: Banking sector NPAs decline to 5-year low, credit growth at 16%
content: The overall banking sector has shown significant improvement as Non-Performing Assets (NPAs) have declined to a 5-year low. Simultaneously, credit growth has surged to 16%, indicating a healthy economy.

title: Central bank hikes interest rates in surprise move
content: In a bid to control rising prices, the RBI raised its key lending rate by 25 basis points to 6.75%. This move was anticipated by some but still surprised the broader market.

title: Tata Motors reports 20% surge in EV sales
content: Tata Motors has reported a massive 20% year-over-year surge in electric vehicle sales, solidifying its dominant position in the Indian EV market. The automotive sector continues to expand.
